environment.description: AWS Lambda function deployed behind API Gateway (HTTP API) with the KMS key configured with EXTERNAL_KEY_STORE origin backed by a CloudHSM cluster (custom key store). The CloudHSM cluster enforces a per-key operation rate limit via the HSM firmware's built-in throttling (max 5 cryptographic operations per second per key handle). Additionally, the API Gateway has a usage plan with throttle settings of 2 requests/second burst and 1 request/second sustained rate. The Lambda function's IAM execution role has a permissions boundary that includes a condition limiting kms:Decrypt calls to a maximum of 100 invocations per 60-second window via an SCP applied at the OU level with a StringEquals condition on aws:PrincipalTag/rate-class set to 'restricted'. CloudWatch anomaly detection alarm triggers Lambda concurrency throttle to 0 when error rate exceeds 3% over a 1-minute window.
